suggestions: I'm grateful for the quiet peace before Fajr that allows me to center my intentions before the rush of the day begins.
I'm thankful for that deeply satisfying moment when a tricky bug that took hours to trace is finally fixed.
I'm grateful for a smooth Friday deployment that goes off without any critical alerts or rollbacks.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a stable job that lets me provide for my family while growing my skills.
I'm grateful for the cooling sound of morning rain outside my window while settling into my desk with a hot teh tarik.
I'm thankful for late-night mamak catch-ups with good friends to decompress after an intense sprint.
I'm grateful for constructive code reviews from senior teammates that help me become a better engineer without feeling discouraged.
I'm thankful for the midday prayer break that pulls me away from the blue light and resets my mental focus.
I'm grateful for a smooth LRT commute with just enough quiet time to listen to a beneficial podcast.
I'm thankful for warm home-cooked meals waiting on the table after a long day of back-to-back technical meetings.
I'm grateful for an iced Milo on a hot afternoon to power me through the final hours of the workday.
I'm thankful for the moments of barakah where my work gets done faster than expected, giving me extra time for myself.
I'm grateful for a comfortable workspace and a stable internet connection that make working from home a breeze.
I'm thankful for slow weekend mornings spent having nasi lemak and catching up with my parents.
I'm grateful for the resilience to handle unexpected server outages and the lessons learned from every post-mortem.
